out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED RAID INSECT SPRAY IN DRY GOODS STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE USE ONLY CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE AT ESTABLISHMENT.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLES OF CLEANING CHEMICAL WITHOUT LABELS DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS OF SPICES AND OIL WITHOUT LABELS DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED OVER VEGETABLE PICKLE IN KRATOS 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: KRATOS 2 DOOR PREP TOP AT 42-45F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPAIR AND DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND ABLE TO MAINTAIN TCS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.
